verdict.rationale: ADK's own docs state that it automatically filters irrelevant events and summarizes older conversational turns while tracking token usage, so it directly addresses context-window management. This comes from a single landing-page sentence, with no detail on how developers configure or control it. Missing for 10: developer-facing configuration or API docs for trimming/summarization/filtering, explicit history truncation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window

citations.quote: ADK automatically filters irrelevant events, summarizes older conversational turns, lazy-loads artifacts, and tracks token usage.
